shortDescription: Create an API token for a user

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: return_token
options.description: Whether to return the actual API token value in the response WARNING: Setting this to true will expose the sensitive API token in Ansible logs, fact cache, and console output

options.name: tokenName
options.description: The name of the created token to identify its session

options.name: user
options.description: The username for the user account for which to generate the API token

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests
